summary: The bad() method takes a user-controlled cookie value and passes it directly to Class.forName()/newInstance(), allowing an attacker to instantiate arbitrary classes (CWE-470 Unsafe Reflection). The fix adds an allowlist check so only a known, safe set of class names can be loaded, while still honoring legitimate cookie values and performing the same reflection/instantiation behavior for valid inputs.
